This was done using 50 field collected (F0) females to estimate the frequency of the 119F-GSTe2 mutation in Gounougou. The TaqMan genotyping of the L119F-GSTe2 in F0 field collected females revealed a high frequency of 119F resistant allele in Gounougou population (52%)
although a slight drop was observed in 2015 to 40% due to a reduction of the homozygote resistant genotype 119F/F (Fig 4A).
